fields.Name: T165 - Testing Overview Dashboard Render
fields.Description: Renders the testing-dashboard-tab aggregation view (KPI cards + live activity + suite-health bars + alerts) that pulls from TestingInstrumentationService — distinct composition unlike any generic list/grid.

InputDefinition.goal: Assume you are already logged in at http://localhost:4200. Open the application switcher next to the logo, choose "Testing", and stay on the default Dashboard tab. Verify the overview renders its composed sections: a KPI card row across the top, a Live Activity card (showing either running tests or a "No tests currently running" idle state), a Recent Runs list, a Suite Health section with pass-rate bars, and an Alerts section. Seeing these sections render (each with either data or a valid empty state) is success — you do NOT need to interact with them. Pages can take 10-30s to load in this resource-constrained environment — wait, don't navigate away.

judgeValidationCriteria: A KPI card row is visible at the top of the overview
The Live Activity card renders (running tests list OR a 'No tests currently running' idle message)
Recent Runs, Suite Health, and Alerts sections each render with data or a valid empty-state message
No error messages, blank screens, or crash pages
